stories.title: Austin Clinch Watch — Antonelli's Window Opens in Eight Days

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
Kimi Antonelli can clinch the 2026 F1 world title in Austin — 8 days away.

Conditions: win the race, Russell P9 or lower, Hamilton P5 or lower.

He leads by 102 points. The clock is ticking. 🏆 #F1

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
If Antonelli wins the title in Austin, he would do it with FIVE races still to go.

One shy of Schumacher's 2002 record for earliest-ever F1 title clinch.

History is within reach. #F1 #KimiAntonelli

stories.title: Verstappen's Momentum — Can Red Bull Spoil Antonelli's Title Party at COTA?

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Max Verstappen won Malaysia. Won Singapore.

He's on a two-race streak. He won COTA in 2025.

The man most likely to ruin Antonelli's title party in Austin knows exactly what he's doing. #F1 #MaxVerstappen

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Verstappen is 119 points behind Antonelli with 150 still available.

Mathematically alive. Momentum real. Red Bull may be developing the 2027 car — but Verstappen is racing the 2026 one. #F1
